# beowulf-fitt-26 — Fitt XXVI · Farewell to Heorot (lines 1817–1887)

71 lines, Klaeber printed pages 68, 69, 70.

## The lines

```
1817  Bēowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþēowes:
1818  ‘Nū wē sǣlīðend secgan wyllað
1819  feorran cumene, þæt wē fundiaþ
1820  Higelāc sēcan. Wǣron hēr tela,
1821  willum bewenede; þū ūs wēl dohtest.
1822  Gif ic þonne on eorþan ōwihte mæg
1823  þīnre mōdlufan māran tilian,
1824  gumena dryhten, ðonne ic gȳt dyde,
1825  gūðgeweorca, ic bēo gearo sōna.
1826  Gif ic þæt gefricge ofer flōda begang,
1827  þæt þec ymbsittend egesan þȳwað,
1828  swā þec hetende hwīlum dydon,
1829  ic ðē þūsenda þegna bringe,
1830  hæleþa tō helpe. Ic on Higelāce wāt,
1831  Gēata dryhten, þēah ðe hē geong sŷ,
1832  folces hyrde, þæt hē mec fremman wile
1833  wordum ond weorcum, þæt ic þē wēl herige
1834  ond þē tō gēoce gārholt bere,
1835  mægenes fultum, þǣr ðē bið manna þearf.
1836  Gif him þonne Hrēþrīc tō hofum Gēata
1837  geþingeð þēodnes bearn, hē mæg þǣr fela
1838  frēonda findan; feorcȳþðe bēoð
1839  sēlran gesōhte þǣm þe him selfa dēah.’
1840  Hrōðgār maþelode him on andsware:
1841  ‘Þē þā wordcwydas wigtig Drihten
1842  on sefan sende; ne hȳrde ic snotorlīcor

1844  Þū eart mægenes strang, ond on mōde frōd,
1845  wīs wordcwida! Wēn ic talige,
1846  gif þæt gegangeð, þæt ðe gār nymeð,
1847  hild heorugrimme Hrēþles eaferan,
1848  ādl oþðe īren ealdor ðīnne,
1849  folces hyrde, ond þū þīn feorh hafast,
1850  þæt þe Sǣ-Gēatas sēlran næbben
1851  tō gecēosenne cyning ǣnigne,
1852  hordweard hæleþa, gyf þū healdan wylt
1853  māga rīce. Mē þīn mōdsefa
1854  līcað leng swā wēl, lēofa Bēowulf.
1855  Hafast þū gefēred, þæt þām folcum sceal,
1856  Gēata lēodum ond Gār-Denum
1857  sib gemǣne, ond sacu restan,
1858  inwitnīþas, þē hīe ǣr drugon,
1859  wesan, þenden ic wealde wīdan rīces,
1860  māþmas gemǣne, manig ōþerne
1861  gōdum gegrēttan ofer ganotes bæð;
1862  sceal hringnaca ofer heafu bringan
1863  lāc ond luftācen. Ic þā lēode wāt
1864  gē wið fēond gē wið frēond fæste geworhte,
1865  ǣghwæs untǣle ealde wīsan.’
1866  Ðā gīt him eorla hlēo inne gesealde,
1867  mago Healfdenes māþmas twelfe;
1868  hēt [h]ine mid þǣm lācum lēode swǣse
1869  sēcean on gesyntum, snūde eft cuman.
1870  Gecyste þā cyning æþelum gōd,
1871  þēoden Scyldinga ðegn[a] betstan
1872  ond be healse genam; hruron him tēaras
1873  blondenfeaxum. Him wæs bēga wēn
1874  ealdum infrōdum, ōþres swīðor,
1875  þæt h[ī]e seoðða(n) [nō] gesēon mōston,
1876  mōdige on meþle. Wæs him se man tō þon lēof,

1879  æfter dēorum men dyrne langað
```

- line 1833: wordum — italic: o

- line 1836: Hrēþrīc — italic: c
- line 1857: gemǣne — italic: e (final)

An italic letter means Klaeber changed the manuscript there. The apparatus below usually gives the manuscript reading; where it matters for the sense, the unit's note says what the manuscript has.

## Readings settled with low confidence at transcription

- line 1883: low-confidence reading: A single circumflex whose apex sits in the gap between e and a (slightly toward e); no separate macron over e.
